title: Unlocking one protected listing makes the next one cheaper
rootCause: ProtectedListings.unlockProtectedListing lowers listingCount before it writes the checkpoint, so the checkpoint is computed from a utilization rate that is already too low, and later unlocks pay less interest.

poc.observable: test_the_second_unlock_costs_what_the_first_did fails with "the second unlock price equals the first: 402055890410801920 != 402485479451875840"
